CONCEPT 01Illustrated elegance
Primary identity Concept 01

Concept 01 / Elegant, expressive, personal

Art in every detail

A graceful hand illustration places the craft of nail artistry at the heart of the brand.

Explore this direction ↓

01 / Design rationale

The illustrated signature

The fine-line hand makes the category immediately clear. Long polished nails, small sparkles and a circular frame give the identity an artistic signature. The contrasting serif wordmark brings a quieter, refined foundation.

I built this direction around the artist’s touch: expressive detail balanced by a composed, elegant wordmark.

02 / Design principles

A considered balance

Clean
A contained circular illustration and a spacious wordmark give the detailed artwork a clear structure.
Premium
Fine lines, restrained serif lettering and warm neutrals create a considered beauty aesthetic.
Artistic
The hand illustration makes the artist’s touch visible. Pink nail gradients add a controlled moment of expression.

03 / Identity

The identity system

Light and dark expressions give the identity flexibility across packaging and digital touchpoints. Select a logo for a closer look.

Identity / Brand components

The individual elements

The icon and wordmark each carry the identity with a distinct role: a recognisable signature and a refined brand name.

04 / Colour

The colour story

A coordinated palette brings consistency to the identity, from its signature tones to supporting neutrals.

Rosewood#854C58Brand colour
Warm nude#E0C8BABrand colour
Soft ivory#FAF8F7Brand colour
Espresso#42262CSupporting colour
Signature pink#E15C8CSupporting colour

05 / In application

On the dressing table

A warm ivory label keeps the delicate linework visible. The complete logo gives the bottle a clear connection to the craft, while the carton offers more room for the illustration.

A practical consideration

The fine detail deserves generous space. The separate icon and wordmark offer flexible options for smaller formats.

CONCEPT 02Expressive luxury
Primary identity Concept 02

Concept 02 / Confident, fluid, glamorous

Luxury with a flourish

A confident serif logo turns the brand name into the main artistic gesture.

Explore this direction ↓

01 / Design rationale

The flowing wordmark

Large, contrasting serif strokes give “Tipsy” a strong presence. The extended tail flows into a pink flourish, suggesting a sweep of polish. The spaced NAILZ lettering gives the expressive silhouette a clear category cue.

I used the flowing flourish to give this direction a confident signature, capturing the movement and creativity of nail colour.

02 / Design principles

A considered balance

Clean
One compact logo composition keeps the name and category together, with a clear hierarchy.
Premium
The dramatic serif lettering and deep wine colour recall the visual language of premium cosmetics.
Artistic
The sweeping tail and layered pink flourish bring movement into the logo itself.

03 / Identity

The identity system

Two complementary logo versions carry the same expressive flourish across light and dark settings. Select a logo for a closer look.

04 / Colour

The colour story

A coordinated palette brings consistency to the identity, from its signature tones to supporting neutrals.

Deep wine#44122ABrand colour
Pale blush#FFD6DABrand colour
Flourish pink#F38BB0Supporting colour
White#FFFFFFSupporting colour
Black#000000Supporting colour

05 / In application

On the dressing table

The dark-background version sits on a deep wine bottle and carton. Blush lettering gives the name contrast, while the pink flourish keeps the application connected to colour and creativity.

A practical consideration

The long flourish is central to the logo. Leave breathing room around it and use a label wide enough to preserve the full composition.

Concept 02 / Expressive luxuryCompare the directions ↓
CONCEPT 03Quiet artistry
Primary identity Concept 03

Concept 03 / Minimal, distinctive, contemporary

A quieter kind of artistry

A refined lowercase logo carries its nail reference within the lettering.

Explore this direction ↓

01 / Design rationale

The typographic detail

The lowercase serif lettering creates a calm, approachable presence. A sparkle above the i adds a small artistic detail. The negative space in the y suggests a nail, giving the wordmark a category reference without a separate illustration.

I kept the artistic gesture within the lettering, creating a quiet identity with a detail that rewards a closer look.

02 / Design principles

A considered balance

Clean
A single typographic composition keeps the identity focused and visually calm.
Premium
The balance of substantial strokes and fine serifs gives the logo a refined editorial character.
Artistic
The nail in the negative space and the sparkle reward a closer look with subtle personality.

03 / Identity

The identity system

Two colour expressions share the distinctive lettering and negative-space nail detail. Select a logo for a closer look.

04 / Colour

The colour story

A coordinated palette brings consistency to the identity, from its signature tones to supporting neutrals.

Dark plum#302039Brand colour
Lavender#B9A0D4Brand colour
Porcelain#FAF7FCBrand colour

05 / In application

On the dressing table

The lavender version appears on a dark plum bottle. The light version sits on a porcelain carton, keeping the packaging calm and allowing the lettering to lead.

A practical consideration

The nail reference is subtle. Maintain the spacing and silhouette so the detail remains visible, especially on smaller packaging.

Concept 03 / Quiet artistryCompare the directions ↓

The decision

Three ways to feel like Tipsy

Each direction balances clarity, premium appeal and artistic personality. The distinction is how that personality comes to life.

01

Illustrated elegance

Personality lives in the hand illustration.

Strongest emphasis

A visible connection to nail artistry and an intimate beauty feel.

Packaging consideration

The fine detail benefits from generous label space.

02

Expressive luxury

Personality lives in the flowing wordmark.

Strongest emphasis

Confident shelf presence with a bold, glamorous signature.

Packaging consideration

The complete flourish needs room to remain clear.

03

Quiet artistry

Personality lives in the typographic detail.

Strongest emphasis

A calm premium identity with a subtle category reference.

Packaging consideration

The negative-space nail rewards careful sizing.

Which expression feels most like Tipsy Nailz: the artist’s hand, an expressive flourish, or a subtle detail in the lettering?
